local p = {}
local data    = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData-Test/Data2')
local data2    = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data')

function toNil(thing)
	if thing==nil or thing=='' then return nil else return thing end
end


local duplicateData = {} 

-- Копирование данных из исходной переменной data в дубликат без поля upgrade
for character, characterData in pairs(data) do
    -- Проверка наличия поля upgrade в персонаже
    if characterData.upgrade and not toNil(data2[character])then
    	--  and toNil(data2[character])
        -- Копирование данных персонажа в дубликат
        duplicateData[character] = characterData
    end
end


function p.loli(f) 

function returnToText(data)
    local function tableToString(tbl, indent)
        indent = indent or 0
        local str = ""
        local indentStr = string.rep("  ", indent)
        local keys = {}

        for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
            table.insert(keys, k)
        end

        table.sort(keys)

        for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
            local v = tbl[k]

            local keyStr
            if type(k) == "string" then
                keyStr = k
            else
                keyStr = "[" .. tostring(k) .. "]"
            end

            str = str .. indentStr .. keyStr .. " = "
            if type(v) == "table" then
                str = str .. "{\n" .. tableToString(v, indent + 1) .. indentStr .. "},"
            elseif type(v) == "string" then
                str = str .. '"' .. tostring(v) .. '",'
            else
                str = str .. tostring(v) .. ","
            end

            str = str .. "\n"
        end

        return str
    end

    return "data = {\n" .. tableToString(data, 1) .. "}"
end

return f:preprocess('<syntaxhighlight lang="lua" line>'.. returnToText(duplicateData) ..'</syntaxhighlight>')
	
	
end

return p
